title: Weird Science: Dino Blood, Mouse Brains & Rocket Retirements
briefing: Three wild studies and one space shake-up — can you spot the line that got snipped?

posts.body: Scientists have studied plenty of dinosaur bones, eggs and footprints. Now, they've found their strongest evidence yet of dinosaur blood.
As it races to develop its new massive rocket, the space launch company is preparing to retire NASA's main ride to the International Space Station.
Brain scientists set up "gladiator style" cage matches for mice — and found that simply observing fighting matches can rewire a mouse's brain to resemble those who actually fought.
